subject: Novacorp: next steps for vendor security questionnaire and SOC 2 scope
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Novacorp: next steps for vendor security questionnaire and SOC 2 scope

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have aligned expectations: 

Summary from our side:
- NovaCorp is evaluating Redwood for inference across two pilot apps (Recommendations and Support Summaries).
- Primary security asks: SOC 2 status, HIPAA applicability for health-adjacent data in Support Summaries, and EU data residency for a subset of logs.
- You prefer starting with SIG v2 (standard prefill) but mentioned a short custom addendum the Legal team may attach.

Proposed next steps:
1) We’ll initiate a SIG prefill and send the doc for your review (target: EOD Monday).
2) Can you confirm which of the following are in-scope for the evaluation?
   - PHI (yes/no) for Support Summaries
   - EU-resident customer data retention requirements
   - Any required encryption-at-rest KMS provider (customer-managed or Redwood-managed)
3) If Legal wants to use a different questionnaire (internal CAIQ or in-house), please share it and we’ll respond in parallel.

Attachments: I’m including a short SOC 2 summary and a proposed SIG scope PDF for the pilot.

If that plan works, I’ll kick off the SIG prefill and loop Camila for technical evidence and Ben for contract/terms.

Thanks,

— Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
Attachment: Novacorp_SIG_Scope.pdf (proposed scope)
From: Tom Riley <tom.riley@novacorp.com>
To: Priyom Das <priom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Park <leah.park@novacorp.com>, SecurityOps <secops@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 16:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Novacorp: next steps for vendor security questionnaire and SOC 2 scope

Thanks, Priyom — solid recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- PHI: The Support Summaries will ingest support ticket text that can contain customer PII but not structured PHI fields. We need HIPAA controls documented but it's not our primary PHI workload yet.
- EU residency: We need logs and any persistent transcript data for EU customers to remain in EU regions. Temp inference cache acceptable in us-west for speed, but must not be persisted.
- KMS: We prefer customer-managed keys for production; for pilot OK with Redwood-managed, but include the steps required to switch to our KMS.

Leah (Legal) will review the SIG v2 prefill but might attach a short addendum (1 page) with liability/retention language. SecurityOps asked for an initial evidence pack (SOC 2 bridge doc, encryption config, and a tech contact).

Can you include the following specific clarifying questions in the SIG prefill email so we can circulate internally?
1) Is Redwood’s SOC 2 report current and can you provide a redacted copy?
2) Which SOC 2 trust services were included (security, availability, confidentiality, processing integrity, privacy)?
3) Do you support customer-managed KMS key rotation and HSM-backed keys?
4) Can you detail the data-at-rest encryption and where keys are stored (region/partner)?

Tom
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
NovaCorp

--- email to SIG owners ---
From: Priyom Das <priom.das@redwood.com>
To: sig@redwood.com
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Subject: Novacorp SIG v2 prefill request — DC-2026-1147

Hello —
We’re initiating a SIG v2 prefill on behalf of Novacorp (pilot evaluation). Please find the scope and a few clarifying questions below. Requested turnaround: 5 business days.

Scope highlights:
- Pilot covers two apps: Recommendations (non-PII content) and Support Summaries (ticket text, possible PII).
- EU data residency required for persisted transcripts/logs; temporary inference cache allowed in us-west.
- Production will require customer-managed KMS; pilot ok with Redwood-managed.

Clarifying questions to include in prefill response:
1) SOC 2 report availability: can provide redacted copy and Bridge letter?
2) Trust services in scope (list): security, availability, confidentiality, processing integrity, privacy
3) KMS: customer-managed key patterns supported; HSM options and steps to migrate
4) Data retention controls and region-specific storage options
5) Evidence for encryption at-rest and in-transit (config snippets acceptable)
6) Any HIPAA-relevant controls (BAA: current stance and timeline)

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf, Novacorp_SIG_Scope.pdf

--- end email ---

Camila — can you confirm the exact artifact names we’ll attach for evidence (e.g., KMS diagram, encryption config snippet, SOC2 redacted) so I can include them? Ben — can you confirm if Legal should expect a mapped contract checklist alongside the SIG?

If I don’t hear edits by EOD I’ll submit and share the HubSpot record link.

Thanks,
Priyom
